news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹16.32 (vs ₹10.22 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹16.32 (up from ₹10.22 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹1.38b (up 59% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹190.4m (up 62% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 14% (in line with FY 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 39% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 24% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.4% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (currently running at an operating cash loss). news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.72 (vs ₹2.42 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.72 (up from ₹2.42 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹303.4m (up 157% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹43.0m (up 54% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 14% (down from 24% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 33% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 31% per year.

news.body: After last week's 17% share price gain to ₹319, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 26x. Average trailing P/E is 29x in the Pharmaceuticals industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 159% over the past three years.

news.title: Trident Lifeline Limited (BSE:543616) acquired an additional 9% stake in Trident Mediquip Limited for INR 44.2 million.
news.body:
Trident Lifeline Limited (BSE:543616) acquired an additional 9% stake in Trident Mediquip Limited for INR 44.2 million on January 1, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 44.2 million will be paid by Trident Lifeline Limited. As a result of the transaction, the stake of Trident Lifeline in Trident Mediquip Limited has increased from 51% to 60.04%

For the financial year 2024-25, Trident Mediquip Limited reported total revenue of INR 212.9 million.


Trident Lifeline Limited (BSE:543616) completed the acquisition of an additional 9% stake in Trident Mediquip Limited on January 1, 2026.

news.title: Trident Lifeline Limited Announces the Resignation of Maniya H Desai as Non-Executive Director, Effective November 21, 2025
news.body: Trident Lifeline Limited announced that Mrs. Maniya H Desai, Non-Executive Director of the Company has vide her resignation letter dated November 21, 2025, resigned from the Board of the Company with effect from the closure of business hours on November 21, 2025. The Board of Directors has taken note of the resignation of Mrs. Maniya H Desai. Reason of Resignation: Personal reason.
